$comment: The JSON twin of adp-default.projected.yaml, generated from it. Do not edit either alone: `the_projection_reads_the_same_from_yaml_and_from_json` fails when they drift. JSON holds no comments, so the YAML carries the projection's own header and this file cannot.

run.summary: Take in the request and record what is being asked for, unedited.
State the required behaviour. Anything left only in the prompt cannot be checked later, so this is where an objective becomes something a verifier can disagree with.
Break the specification into units that can each be implemented and verified on their own.
Write the tests, contracts and checks that will decide whether the work is done — before there is an implementation for them to be shaped around.
Make the smallest change that satisfies the decomposed unit and its verifiers.
Run the verifiers established earlier against the change.
Try to break what the previous state just declared working: mutants, edge cases, property violations, contract drift.
Judge the change as a whole — intent, fit and risk, not just green checks.
